limits: Known-genesis no-op contract; no historical mainnet ABI or contract-compute qualification.
Verified captured ABI history is bootstrapped into a new isolated ABI index before replay.
Finite reader/deserializer/pool/indexer correctness run, not sustained throughput or automatic ABI discovery.
No reset, purge or deletion is exposed; exact fixture cleanup is a separate ownership-checked command.
Qualifier shutdown bypasses production gracefulStop checkpoint persistence; a null Redis cursor is not synthesized. #195 remains open for persisted checkpoint and restart acceptance.
No throughput, CPU profile, automatic ABI discovery, historical mainnet, fork recovery, contract computation, state projection or host power-loss durability claim.
Failed pilots are excluded. Their report source hash metadata is retained; final measured source/build/native binary snapshots are archived in full.
Known public genesis key and isolated fixture test credentials are retained as raw evidence; no production credentials are included.
